title: Visual regression testing
proves: Every P0 and P1 page at the viewports its priority asks for has a committed baseline (95% or more, checked on every pull request, so a new page without one fails), every scenario matches its baseline on a seeded stack with the clock, language, time zone, animation and dates fixed, every P0 scenario gives the same answer on every one of its repeated runs (zero flaky P0), and a deliberate change to a page is caught.
doesNotProve: Other browsers (Chromium only; cross-browser is task 19), other operating systems (baselines are Linux Chromium), pages that need data ([id] and [token] routes), pages in the operator, embedded and setup groups, interaction states beyond the first paint, or the look of real customer data (the seeded workspace is mostly empty).
